name: THE DARKNESS AGAIN
source:
A collection of four scenarios to progress simultaneously with choice in one scenario affecting others.
Horny beast from the other world can not suffice with just one girl. It reaches its tentacles to the ground is search for a new victim...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
四个场景的集合，同时进行，其中一个场景的选择会影响其他场景。
来自异世界的性欲猛兽，只靠一个女孩是不够的。它把触手伸向地面，寻找新的受害者……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
